content: Root cause: The bug was caused by false cache hits in the queryResultCache due to the equality of hashCodes when duplicate filter queries were present in requests. The original implementation used a simple summation of filter hashCodes for key generation, which led to collisions when filters with the same hashCode were included in different arrangements. This resulted in incorrectly treated cache entries when the actual filter lists were different but had identical hashCodes. The fix implemented an unordered comparison for filters to ensure proper equality checking, eliminating the false cache hits.
